content.short: Ankr Liquid Staking provides 1:1 liquid staking tokens (e.g., ankrMATIC, ankrETH) usable across DeFi platforms for rewards or swaps.
content.description: Ankr Liquid Staking brings the benefits of DeFi to the masses by offering Liquid Staking, Delegated Staking, DeFi, Bridge, Switch, and Parachain Crowdloan. In traditional staking, assets are locked on-chain to help secure networks, which can lock up liquidity. Liquid Staking resolves this by issuing tokens that are worth 1:1 with the staked asset, giving instant liquidity. These portable tokens, such as ankrMATIC and ankrETH, can be deployed on other DeFi platforms to earn rewards or swapped for other assets.
